title: FOLIO validation: first-order-logic reasoning in natural language
decision: whether a conclusion is true, false or undetermined given a set of premises

source.name: FOLIO: Natural Language Reasoning with First-Order Logic (arXiv:2209.00840)
source.split: validation, v0.0 (204 rows; test set unreleased)

licence: GitHub LICENSE file: "Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International" (the gated Hugging Face card yale-nlp/FOLIO is tagged "mit")
notes: All 204 rows of the v0.0 validation file: True 72, False 63, Uncertain 69. The rows share 73 premise sets (meta.story, numbered by first appearance), so they are not independent: resample by story for intervals. The file carries no ids; source_id is the line number. The premises (a list in the source) are joined with newlines, nothing else is changed. This is the validation split of FOLIO v0.0 from GitHub: the test set is unreleased, and the corrected release announced in the repository README is on a gated Hugging Face card (login required) and was not used. Validation and training data are public, so a model may have seen them. Decontamination against the training data of the final StartLux-Decision-27B (scan of 10 October 2026, 3,252,020 training records of Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3 and the RL pool): 1 of 204 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it; 203 items remain.
